This plot is small, only about a quarter of my land, but maize is what feeds my family so I must do my best with it. I am hoping to get a coupon from the subsidy this year — if I do, I will put basal NPK and topdress with urea, but I have to spread it carefully because the package is never enough. I keep my goats and chickens, so I will carry some manure to the field before the rains, and I intercrop with pigeon pea to help the soil and give us another food. I cannot afford to hire much labor — my wife and older children will help me with ridging and weeding, and I will only hire a few people if the weeds get ahead of us after the first rains.
